errors.text_span: Вертикалната ос показва площите, изразени в хектари, и има линейна скала, диапазонираща се от 0 до 1200 хектари, с единици в хектари.
errors.evidence: The y-axis label is "Хиляди хектари" (Thousands of hectares), not "хектари" (hectares). This misrepresents all values by a factor of 1000.
The bars are not ordered alphabetically. Within each year's group, the bars are ordered according to the legend (Spain, France, China, etc.), which is not an alphabetical arrangement.

errors.text_span: най-високият стълб съответства на Китай/континентал през 2022 г.
errors.evidence: The highest bars consistently belong to Spain (blue) throughout the period. The bar for Spain in 2013 is the highest overall. The bar for China in 2022 is visibly lower than Spain's bars.

errors.text_span: а най-ниският стълб съответства на САЩ през 2013 г.
errors.evidence: The lowest bars consistently belong to Argentina (dark blue) throughout the period. The bar for the USA in 2013 is significantly higher than any of Argentina's bars.

The description fails to mention that the chart uses a grouped bar structure, where for each year, there is a group of bars representing the different countries. This is a fundamental aspect of how the data is organized and compared.
